title: Keep inside a box
prompt: Return the position pushed back inside a box that runs from (0, 0) to (width, height). Each part is clamped separately.
signature: func solve(position: Vector2, width: float, height: float) -> Vector2:
starter:
func solve(position: Vector2, width: float, height: float) -> Vector2:
	return position
hint: clamp() on x and clamp() on y, or the vector's own clamp method with two corner vectors.
solution:
func solve(position: Vector2, width: float, height: float) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2(clamp(position.x, 0, width), clamp(position.y, 0, height))
